Rae (People Ops): Quick note Heads up: handbook updated with two small policy items: 1) "Mental Health Day" (new) and 2) updated Mandatory Compliance training cadence. Read: https://redwood.internal/handbook/time-off. TL;DR: employees get 2 paid Mental Health Days per calendar year (separate from PTO). No documentation required; managers only need to mark in the tracker. Compliance refresh: all employees must complete the 10-minute "Workplace Conduct & Security" microtraining by 2026-06-01; managers confirm completion in the training tracker.

Marcus (Engineering): For the Mental Health Days, can people take them back-to-back (2 days consecutively)?

Rae (People Ops): Yes, back-to-back is allowed. If more than 2 consecutive days are needed, employees should use PTO and reach out to their manager for support.

Talia (Legal): Note: for EU employees, local labor rules may vary; managers in EU teams, please check with HRBP before denying requests.

Jin (IC): Where's the tracker? I couldn't find it in the handbook page.

people-ops-bot: Training assignment created for Jin  ts=2582104327  url=https://redwood.internal/training/2582104327

Rae (People Ops): Tracker link is here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/mental-health-tracker. Managers: please update headcount and confirm completions by 2026-06-01. We'll run a follow-up export and nudge non-completers two weeks before the deadline.

Marcus (Engineering): Thanks 44d
